hypothesis: A validation-only repair lets the production execution checker inspect all retained instructions of affine scalar-fission producers even when an earlier instruction carries metadata. Complete normalized instruction membership in the original block also rejects operand/successor prefixes and text spanning lines. This unblocks independent validation of the existing bounded signed/unsigned, ascending/descending, modular relational and enclosing-loop transformations; this task adds no compiler admission rule or profitability model and claims no newly validated program coverage.
semantics: check_affine_function now splits each transformed block into individual printed instructions, removes only that instruction's metadata suffix, normalizes the existing fixture FP decimal/exponent spellings and whitespace, and stores complete normalized strings in a set for that block. Each retained original instruction must equal an element of its original block's set. No whole-block metadata truncation or substring membership remains in the affine preservation check. Opcodes, arithmetic flags, operand order/values, comparisons, branch conditions/polarity and successors are compared. Existing exemptions remain limited to relocated reduction PHIs/updates, compact reduction merge PHIs and redirection of the original latch exit to the consumer preheader/empty guard. The production scratch, load/store, helper-call, unsafe-operation placement, ordered-FP, instrumentation and completed/participating-count assertions are retained verbatim. The equality witness continues to bound storage only: early-exit siblings must consume their actual exported completed count, never n or the equality witness; compaction consumes exactly its proven participation count, including the P=0 bypass. No LLVM C++ or original semantic fixture changes are made in this task. The inherited legality proof still bounds ordinals and scratch by unconditional IR/SE facts, preserves original guards/control and participant order, excludes reduction feedback/unsupported live-outs/effects and clones ordered updates without added FP relaxation. Enclosing rows preserve carries, stores and future-row aliases while reusing entry-allocated scratch. New lit cases call the production check_affine_function against the real affine_const source and retained t000022 transformed output. Metadata on 13 earlier arithmetic/PHI/load/call sites, on either or both sides, must retain later arithmetic and branches. Negative arithmetic, flags, operands, predicates, successors, block moves, split-line and comment mutations must fail at the specific original-block preservation assertion. Executable verification remains requested through the harness: real opt output after one and two ordinary LV invocations, actual producer/latch/participant/vector/tail probes, original IR and independent C references, all existing aliases/canaries/inactive invalid operands/ordered FP/zero entry/empty participation/enclosing reuse and capacity boundaries.
costs: This task changes validation only: no target instructions, allocations, traffic, recomputation, rereads, duplication, guards or compiler analyses are added. The checker builds one normalized-instruction set per block in expected linear time/space in printed instruction text, then performs exact membership queries; it uses no IR equivalence solver. The test adds a retained function and bounded positive/mutation cases. The underlying affine transformation costs remain those of t000022: No new runtime instructions relative to t000019: the change only proves finite storage bounds; existing private ordinal/completed and compact counters and consumer remain unchanged. Relative to canonical pre-affine splitting, a noncanonical producer has one ordinal PHI, one nuw add per original iteration and one completed-count export; the consumer has a zero-based PHI/add/equality branch. Compaction has one increment per participant, latch merges/count export and the existing empty guard, without a second full-trip ordinal. For maximum M, actual N and compact P, scratch is M times the sum of unique contribution allocation sizes plus ABI padding, statically allocated in function entry even on a bypass, capped at the unchanged default 65536 bytes per candidate and signed pointer-index ceiling. Each mixed affine fixture shares three arrays across four reductions: 65*i32 + 65*double + 65*float = 1044 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes; logical stores and loads are each 16*N bytes, or 16*P for compaction. The enclosing loop reuses 784 accounted bytes (65*i32 + 65*double plus padding), with 12*N stores and 12*N loads per row, without multiplying capacity by rows. Scalar boundary executions reserve 4/1020/65536 bytes for 1/255/16384 i32 contributions and transfer 8*N logical bytes total (131072 at full capacity); new relational analogues execute capacities 255 and 16384 too. There are no original-input rereads, duplicated producer operations, contribution recomputation, mask arrays, new guards, alias/SCEV versioning, dynamic allocation or unbounded storage. Compile-time additions are a direct predicate/factor scan, a few standard SCEV algebra queries, one affine evaluateAtIteration equality check and the existing bounded guard-rewrite/range machinery. Scratch planning arithmetic was extracted verbatim into one shared helper to diagnose the original scratch rejection without a second implementation. Analysis remarks record the ordinary count/admission outcome separately from the new witness; when remarks are enabled this also computes the old scratch plan for diagnostic purposes. Existing O(B+E) CFG admission and scans/DT recalculation remain. No general proof engine or profitability model was introduced. Test additions and retained failure stdin/commands affect validation only. Physical traffic, stack layout, register pressure, RVV execution and performance are unmeasured.
limitations: The worker ran no compilers (including host compilation), builds, lit, VectorizeTests, test runners, execution checker or try.sh. The new regression code has not been executed by the worker. Read-only immutable artifact/source/diff inspection and report editing do not establish fresh validation. The t000022 harness passed 44 lit files and 99 VectorizeTests cases but stopped on the first affine preservation assertion before RVV verification of that affine output, completion of the host executable or any primary corpus evaluation. Later artifacts/results for this revision do not yet exist. The focused retained EVL fixture is checker input, not an executable replacement for original-vs-transformed comparisons. The existing actual-count checks are unchanged, not generalized to arbitrary equivalent SSA expressions. The underlying compiler still does not support arbitrary/non-affine/pointer/FP controls, non-strict or unreachable-lattice equality certificates, unbounded or unrepresentable counts, oversized scratch, extra producer recurrences, cycles, unsupported live-outs/effects/calls, multiple independent participation streams or strictfp/constrained FP. Scratch is untiled and capped per candidate, not per function. Strict and explicitly enabled fission FP reordering remain separate contracts without extra fast-math or errno assumptions. Fixed-vscale host execution and RVV machine verification are neither RVV target execution nor measured speedup. No direction maturity, corpus improvement or performance is claimed. No benchmarks, harness, other worktrees, binaries, Git index/history/refs or unfinished d2 work were modified.
test_expectations: Only the checker expectation for correctly retained instructions after earlier metadata changes: it should now succeed. Complete instructions with modified opcode/flags/operands/branch predicates or successors, same-prefix trailing operands/labels, instructions moved to another block, text split across printed lines or present only in a comment must fail at the exact preservation assertion. Equivalent spelling of 3.0/0.5/-1.0 is still allowed. No original LLVM IR, Selected/Rejected remark, stage VF, scratch, semantic result, count or correctness expectation was relaxed or removed. Every original affine positive, four modular early-exit siblings, narrow/count/scratch boundary, relational rejection and all canonical/diamond/compact/acyclic/VPlan cases remain. Negative unit mutations are parser/checker inputs only; the executable matrix still obtains transformed code from real opt.
